Thanks for this.

Please note that I am not currently taking code contributions — see CONTRIBUTING.md. If we have not already discussed this change in an issue or a discussion, please open one instead and I will read it properly.

If we did agree this one, a quick check before you submit:

- It is one logical change.
- The suite is green.
- No test was weakened or deleted to make it green.
- No prose in help/ was edited. If this change makes a help article untrue, say which article and what is now untrue in it.
- Nothing under vendor/ was edited.
- The commit message says why, not only what.
